name: S1. Category and channel profitability
rawText:
# Do you know which product categories generate the most profit across your sales channels?
# - Which product categories generate the highest gross profit?
# - Which sales channels contribute the most revenue for each product category?
# - Which product categories attract the highest number of orders?
# - How many units are we selling across different product categories and sales channels?
# - How much revenue are we generating after discounts?
# - Which product categories receive the highest discounts, and how does that affect profitability?
# - What is the average revenue generated per order for each product category?
# - Are there product categories generating high sales volumes but relatively low profits?
# - Which product categories and sales channels should we prioritize to maximize profitability?
# __________________________________________________

CategoryChannelProfitability is OrderItems:
    Product.Category Category,
    Order.Channel Channel,
    Count(distinct OrderId) OrdersContainingCategory,
    Sum(Quantity) UnitsSold,
    Sum(Quantity * UnitPrice - DiscountAmount).Round(2) NetRevenue,
    Sum(DiscountAmount).Round(2) Discounts,
    Sum(Quantity * (UnitPrice - Product.CostPrice) - DiscountAmount).Round(2) GrossProfit,
    (Sum(Quantity * UnitPrice - DiscountAmount) * 1.0 / Count(distinct OrderId)).Round(2) AverageCategoryRevenuePerOrder
  Where Order.Status = <Completed>
  Order GrossProfit DESC
  Take 10
